display_name: LoRa 原生 8,192 点同信道独立加噪的两阶段恢复（Full）
description: Matched native two-stage recovery. Supervise the first stage toward an independent noisy view with or without the input channel action. Frozen E104 supervises only the second stage.
authorization: Active LoRa native raw performance goal, frozen E104 training loss and high-confidence source clean U_s pseudo-label authorization.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: Two complex 8192-point native inputs are generated only in training. The actual observation is matched in the two arms and is the only inference input.
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Noisy waveform pairs come only from lawful L_s/U_s source IQ using generic simulation not registered practical settings. Train sees only paired waveforms, no exact action/noise trace, target or V. Real labels L_s only; U_s uses the fixed E104 clean confidence .95 pseudo-label for stage two.

checkpoint.initialization: Both load the same immutable native E104 18k parent for stage one. Add seeded time/spectral second stage with zero complex output, and reset AdamW. Total 325480 trainable G parameters. E104 fully frozen.

sources.role: Same raw observation contract and pretarget source-qualified initialization. Recursively verify formal archival parent.
Same-contract G initialization and archived Full comparison.
Frozen source training teacher and evaluation default head.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: The native parent passed a declared source rule before deployment. Target results never select fitting, hyperparameters, thresholds or retry.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Both freeze at 20000. Only shared_action_native can promote. Six exceeds control, original native parent, historical W24 and all declared source controls. Low exceeds matched arm and reaches other controls. Clean at least raw parent/direct, on same 300 source V packets.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 [6,7,2,0,3], min 12 GiB actual free and <8 contexts, at most two workers and one per card.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on failed matched native parent, true CE or clean pseudo CE missing in second-stage gradients, first-stage witness gradient missing, final CE reaching upstream, nonfinite loss or invalid freeze. No Full if source does not qualify.

notes: Both generate actual channel-applied observation plus independent additive noise and an independent noisy witness. Only whether the witness mean includes the same generic propagation action differs. Both use the same witness noise draw.

One-third pure noise at -8..4 dB, 10% exact source identity, otherwise generic amplitude/time phase jitter, delay echo/image and independent noise at -4..24 dB; no use of registered practical parameters or outcomes.

Original native backbone is first stage. It learns from 0.75 center W24 linear MSE + 0.25 raw MSE to the witness and a raw identity MSE for true L_s clean. Stage two uses stopped-gradient stage-one outputs, fixed E104 true/pseudo CE, paired raw waveform/spectral and clean identity/KL.

Second stage combines dechirped per-chirp time and frequency residuals with observation and estimate, zero initial correction and 35% of observed chirp RMS cap on pointwise correction. Both arms share all architecture.
300 fixed source V packets then optional 30000-packet 15-receiver Full with frozen E104 and independent truth-last.
